question: Do the four unresolved class toggles preserve the coupled J1-and-J3 witness intersection under a simple late map?
number: All four remaining deltas have SAT joint splits at both epsilon values with f,e2 fixed and h fixed; seven affine h transforms also remain SAT in both rows.
notes: Negative only for the tested fixed-f/e2 and simple affine h-map families; it neither proves nor refutes universal class invariance. No saving credited.
